text: Free co-op demo: four players, one warehouse, and physics that hate you.
You ride around on a bouncy ball and grab cargo with a tether called ROPE.
Pack it, stack it, ship it, and try not to break it.
Best moment in the trailer: someone gets trapped inside the giant box they're meant to deliver.
There's a wobbly cardboard bridge, and even a quick game of football.
The catch? The graphics are simple and flat.
The whole demo is about four hundred megabytes, in English, German and Polish.
Worth a dip with friends who can take a little yelling.
